## Deleted files

432 files the patch set deletes; 0 still present.

## Not part of this build (by the patch policy)

- group 01.MEDIA: VA-API / VDPAU / PulseAudio. Windows uses DXVA2/D3D11VA through Media Foundation and WASAPI, already implemented in Gecko. Needs a Windows-native rewrite, not a port.

## How to re-run this

Clone the public repository, port the patch set to the stated upstream commit, build and install, then run `fieldkit build-harness claims <task> --strict` from Fieldkit. Every number above is recomputed from the tree, the installed build and the claims register; nothing is carried over from an earlier run.
